title: Retract transfer for filtered cover
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $X$ a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated finite-type $k$-curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], $j:U\to X$ an open immersion, $r$ a prime, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb Z/r\mathbb Z)$, and $G$ a finite locally constant $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] on $U$. Let $v:V\to U$ be finite etale and $H=v_*v^*G$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume all eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold for $j_!H$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Suppose $\rho:H\to G$ retracts the adjunction unit $G\to H$. Then all eight assertions hold for $j_!G$.

proof.text: Apply j_! to the unit and its specified retraction. For nonzero r-torsion sheaves the primary characteristic condition forces p=r; invertible-order torsion forces r invertible in k, otherwise G is zero and its pullback and pushforward are zero. Constructibility is preserved by finite locally constant pullback, finite pushforward and extension by zero. Thus the larger sheaf has the required conditional hypotheses. Cohomology retractions preserve vanishing and finiteness, and the natural comparison maps are retracts preserving bijectivity and surjectivity. Descend all assertions to j_!G.

proof_origin: Stacks 03SD: descend the eight assertions from j_!(v_*v^*G) to j_!G using the supplied unit retraction and verification of the conditional coefficient hypotheses.
